# M&W Labs

> M&W Labs is an independent digital studio based in Demra, Dhaka, Bangladesh, collaborating with founders and teams worldwide.

M&W Labs builds websites, software, SaaS platforms, brands, digital marketing campaigns, content, AI automation, and growth systems. The studio combines development, design, marketing, and strategy.

Contact: hello@mwlabs.digital
Phone: +44 20 3769 7100
